businessModel: Bring your own ChatGPT/Claude subscription or API key; pricing page not reviewed
paidNote: Pricing page not retrieved; BYO model subscription or API key
summary: Chromium desktop browser from a YC F25 startup. Agent tabs, scheduled tasks and an agent-safe Vault password manager that keeps credentials from the model. Mostly macOS; BYO ChatGPT/Claude subscription.
bestFor: Mac users wanting an agent to work through logged-in sites

pros.title: Agent-safe passwords
pros.detail: Aside Vault autofills credentials without exposing them to the AI; credential use is logged.

pros.title: Local memory
pros.detail: Tasks, memory and data stay on device per the vendor, with Secure Enclave encryption claimed.

pros.title: Bring your own model
pros.detail: Use your ChatGPT or Claude subscription or an API key.

pros.title: Scheduled and background agents
pros.detail: Agent tabs and recurring jobs such as a daily briefing.

cons.title: Mostly macOS
cons.detail: Sources disagree on Windows; browserating says "currently available for macOS".

cons.title: Self-reported benchmarks
cons.detail: Top ranks on Online-Mind2Web, BU-Bench and Odysseys are company claims.

cons.title: Small team
cons.detail: Eight employees reported (another source says three).

cons.title: Opaque pricing
cons.detail: Plans not listed on the home page.

faq.a: macOS on Apple Silicon is confirmed; one source lists Windows, others say Mac only.

faq.q: Does it send my data to model providers?
faq.a: Vendor says nothing is shared with LLM providers beyond tasks you run; unverified independently.
Browserating lists Speedometer 3.1 = 41.32 on Apple Silicon macOS.

timeline.event: Accepted into Y Combinator Fall 2025 batch (F25)

spec.sandbox: Sandbox isolating filesystem and network access for agents

pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: Local memory and Secure Enclave claimed; cloud models
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
securityHardening: Sandboxed agent plus Chromium; claims unverified
patchSpeed: Follows Chromium stable; lag not independently measured
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
passwords: Aside Vault autofill hidden from the AI
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
